title: Architecture-contract gate violation log (越权日志)
description: The contract every arch_contract_<lang>.py emits (stdout JSON) and the convergence loop consumes. `passed` and `findings[].severity` drive the Blocker decision. Every arch gate MUST conform; adding a field requires updating this schema AND infra/test/violation_log_schema.py's validator if it uses a new keyword. Validated in infra/test/smoke_gates.py.

passed.description: True iff no finding has severity 'blocker'.

severity.description: 'blocker' fails the gate (outer-ring rewrite); 'warning' is informational.
